verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated SOC 2 product with automated tests, evidence collection, AI evidence review and continuous monitoring (vanta-docs-10, vanta-docs-34, vanta-docs-49). It supports auditor collaboration and audit readiness, with Information Request Lists and audit evidence managed in-platform (vanta-docs-11, vanta-docs-29, vanta-docs-8). It also offers a library of pre-built controls (vanta-docs-61) and AI-drafted policies (vanta-docs-15). Missing for 10: explicit evidence distinguishing Type I vs Type II audit workflows, Trust Services Criteria named as the built-in control set, SOC 2-specific policy templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
